# Weng Loi Machinery Engineering 永來機械工程 / 永来机械工程

> Machine shop in Ipoh, Perak, Malaysia, operating since 1989. Repair and reconditioning of machinery parts, CNC machining, manual machining (up to ø1,600 mm swing and 4 m turning length), prototyping, modification, and welding and fabrication. Quotes by WhatsApp: +60 17-701 4268.

Weng Loi Machinery Engineering was founded by Choo Tuon Loi. Team of 19. English and Chinese (Simplified) content is available.

## Key facts

- Location: No 5 & 7, Hala Menglembu Timur 1, Kawasan Perindustrian Ringan Menglembu Timur, 31450 Ipoh, Perak, Malaysia
- Opening hours: Monday to Friday 8:30 am to 7:30 pm; Saturday and Sunday 8:30 am to 5:30 pm
- Maximum turning length: 4 m (4,000 mm); maximum swing ø1,600 mm; 24 manual horizontal lathes
- CNC: 3 CNC lathes (up to ø440 mm x 820 mm) and 1 CNC machining centre (1,000 x 500 mm table, 700 kg max load)
- Materials: steels, non-ferrous metals, plastics, composites
- Phone / WhatsApp: +60 17-701 4268 (Lily). Email: wlmec.eng@gmail.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/weng_loi_machinery/
- Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/nK4toVswdyoJfBtD9

## Pages

- [Home (English)](https://www.wengloi.com/): services, process, work gallery, capacity table, team, contact

## Services

- Repair and reconditioning: worn shafts, gears, rollers and rotors restored to specification
- CNC machining: one-off or batch parts
- Manual machining: large, odd and urgent jobs, up to ø1,600 mm and 4 m long
- Prototyping: from drawing, sample or sketch; reverse-engineering from a worn original
- Modification: resizing, re-boring, keyways and threads
- Welding and fabrication: build-up welding before re-machining, general fabrication

## How to get a quote

WhatsApp a photo, drawing or sample of the part to +60 17-701 4268. A phone photo with rough dimensions is enough to start.
